title: todos + scratchpads: stores, verbs, project-level sections
description:
The swarm's shared memory. Project-scoped (sections render between the project row and its worktrees), NOT worktree-scoped like commands/checks.

- Stores: model both on the append+cursor+event pattern of src/persist/channels.rs (channel transcripts). channel.note (src/api/schema/channels.rs:60-71) is the nearest cousin but lacks sectioning/search — new stores, same shape. Todos carry: title, state (open/done), blockers, assignee (agent), origin. Scratchpads: named markdown docs, append_section, find.
- Verbs: todo.create/complete/list, scratchpad.write/append_section/find — 5-step Method pattern (see E2 description for the anchors), plus events (remember: a new EventKind is TWO lists — EventKind AND PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENT_KINDS in src/api/schema/events.rs, or plugin hooks silently no-op; per AGENTS.md).
- MCP: one ALLOWLIST line per verb (src/mcp/tools.rs:20-32). This closes the last soloterm-MCP gaps (shared todos, scratchpads) — process control/agent-spawn/waits are already covered by existing verbs once allow-listed.
- Sidebar: TODOS section (n/m = done/total) and NOTES section at project level, using E3's section shapes, height-1 rows, collapsed_space_keys namespaces.

title: project=channel + srt orchestrator + ecosystem hooks
description:
Identity: the project's name IS its channel (CNB <-> #cnb). Not new mechanics — is_auto_channel (sidebar.rs:737) and effective_visual_group (:751) already half-merge channels and groups; close the loop from the project side.

- Creating a project creates/binds #<slug> (channel.create verb exists). Agents spawned in member workspaces auto-join. Rename/re-bind semantics + auto-join opt-out: decide in-bead, document in the design file.
- Orchestrator: project may declare {agent, member, run_file}. Spawn via agent.start (src/api/schema/agents.rs:164-173; start_agent src/app/agents.rs:145-227) WRAPPED IN srt (anthropic-experimental/sandbox-runtime; npm @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime): allowRead = all member dirs; allowWrite = [] EXCEPT .bora/ for the dagr run_file; unix-socket allowlist admits exactly bora's socket; network per srt domain allowlist. Injected instruction: read everything, research allowed, orchestrate via #<channel>, TO EDIT ASK A WORKER. Fence tools with bora mcp serve --channels <slug> (src/mcp/tools.rs:37-46). Orchestrator CAN write todos/scratchpads (E7) — they live behind the socket, not the filesystem.
- Orchestrator's workspace renders as ordinary workspace row, first under the project, distinct glyph. No new row shape.
- herdr-dagr (integrate when present, never absorb): run_file convention .bora/run.json; project right-click 'open dagr' via plugin.action.invoke open-dagr; skip silently when plugin absent.
- herdr-plus (detect-and-integrate, never require): defaults.open_with may be 'herdr-plus open <template>'; per-member template: field; fall back to bora's own open when absent.

title: sidebar view B: project -> worktree -> workspace tree
description:
The new Project view, switchable. group_workspaces_by_repo: bool becomes a 3-way mode (Flat | Repo | Project), persisted. Repo view is NOT touched — its 81 tests stay valid.

Levels: PROJECT row (name, swatch, n/m live workspaces) -> WORKTREE row (repo+branch, ahead/behind, PR badge; keyed by GitSpaceMetadata.checkout_key — the level that is absent today: grouping never reads checkout_key, only repo_identity at sidebar.rs:795+ and branch at :1184) -> WORKSPACE row (state dot, @wNpN, idle age; NEVER the repo name). Repo name appears exactly once per row-path. Single-repo project collapses the repo column. Unopened worktrees (bora worktree list, src/cli/worktree.rs) render dimmed as an open affordance.

Multi-pane: a workspace with 2+ panes gets one child row per pane (cardinality Workspace 1-N Tab 1-N Pane, workspace.rs:260 / tab.rs:45; workspace_agent_label takes only the FIRST pane via pane_details().next(), sidebar.rs:508-529 — the reachable shape 'bora pane split' + 'bora agent start --pane' would otherwise become invisible). One pane = one row, exactly as today.

Also: section-header row shape (glyph + UPPERCASE name + fill rule + right-aligned n/m), SectionHeader/SectionItem entry variants, collapse via collapsed_space_keys new namespaces (persisted, snapshot.rs:28, test :899-904). All rows height 1 — entry_row_height keeps returning 1; write the adversarial characterization test FIRST (extend workspace_list_lockstep_passes_agree_for_git_repo_group, sidebar.rs:5615, with AppState::test_with_adversarial_identity_state()).

Deletions (after the new view lands): agent panel (16 agent_panel_* fns :1414-1530 + :100-243, render_agent_detail :2582), section divider (sidebar_section_heights :61, expanded_sidebar_sections :78, sidebar_section_divider_rect :90), DragTarget::{SidebarSectionDivider, AgentPanelScrollbar}, AppState.{agent_panel_scroll, agent_panel_sort, sidebar_section_split} + persistence sites (SessionSnapshot.sidebar_section_split is Option — old snapshots read fine; update capture_from_state positional args snapshot.rs:274-293,:559-564 and ~8 struct literals in restore.rs/io.rs in the same commit). GREP EVERY DELETED SYMBOL BEFORE THE BATCH. Layout change MUST call AppState::request_full_repaint().

Right-click assembly: add-to-project / rename / toggle CHECKS / choose commands — menu actions write through the E2 verbs.

title: project store: projects.yml, watcher, socket verbs, MCP writers
description:
Foundation for the Project view. A project is user-declared: name, channel, members (directories), sections, orchestrator. Single store, many writers, ONE reader (the sidebar reads the file + watch; never writes).

- Schema (design section 'Composition model'): defaults{open_with, checks, commands} + projects.<slug>{name, channel, members[{dir, worktrees: all|this}], orchestrator{agent, member, run_file}, sections{checks: [providers], commands: [names]}}. Member identity is a DIRECTORY; repo/checkout/subdir derived via existing git discovery (path -> GitSpaceMetadata, src/workspace/git/discovery.rs:4-14). repo: does not exist in the schema.
- Store at ~/.config/bora/projects.yml; serde_yaml or equivalent; parse errors -> toast + keep last good, never panic.
- Socket verbs project.list/create/update/member_add/member_remove via the 5-step Method pattern: (1) Method variant + params src/api/schema.rs:44-277 + new src/api/schema/projects.rs; (2) api_method_name arm src/api/server.rs:411-503; (3) catch-all dispatch_to_app handles plain verbs; (4) app-side match src/app/api.rs:1035-1356 -> handle_* in src/app/api/projects.rs; (5) responses::encode_success/error.
- MCP: one ALLOWLIST line each in src/mcp/tools.rs:20-32 — this is what lets an orchestrator assemble its own project at runtime.

title: sidebar view A polish: honest truncation + de-duplicated child rows
description:
Two surgical fixes to the EXISTING Repo view. Independent of everything else; ships first.

1. Header/branch labels are never truncated — ratatui hard-clips them (looks broken: 'arycast [docs/bd-blast-radius-'). Wrap ProjectHeaderBranch.label (sidebar.rs:2031) and BranchHeader.label (:2175) in truncate_end (src/ui/text.rs:11-24) using the same width-budget arithmetic the Workspace arm does at :2496-2505.
2. An indented Workspace row repeats the repo name the parent header already shows (built raw from ws.display_name_from at :2402). Drop the repo-derived name on indented rows; render only what is unique: the @wNpN pane badge (workspace_agent_label, :508-529, already computed at :2485) plus the branch ONLY when it differs from what the parent header printed. custom_name passes through verbatim.

DO NOT reuse grouped_child_display_label (:718-733): it is mobile-switcher-scoped (sole caller src/ui/mobile.rs:720) and returns the BRANCH name — two same-branch workspaces would render identical rows again.
